review_observations: Windows GetProcessMemoryInfo structure/signatures and PeakWorkingSetSize selection are consistent with a process working-set peak. Linux ru_maxrss is converted from KiB to bytes; macOS ru_maxrss remains bytes. Unsupported platforms and observation exceptions remain explicitly unavailable.

Memory scope includes worker interpreter/import/input overhead up to the observation before final reply output. Aggregation retains missing samples and reports maxima rather than summing process peaks or presenting them as solver-only allocation.

Timing scope now explicitly separates worker-entry preparation, function evaluation, result JSON serialization and input post-check. Worker-body time includes observation but excludes final reply output; wall time includes process startup/output. Overlapping metrics are not additive.

Canonical-digest comparison binds expected job payloads and recorded arm executions to retained reply/process records, preserving JSON type distinctions. Process argv and recorded source/input/reply paths are reconciled; all expected worker jobs are accounted for.
Verification exposes benchmark_status separately from local consistency status. It does not claim authenticated execution provenance.
The adapter and worker boot are scoped and restored on ordinary call exceptions. Concurrent caller threads remain explicitly unsupported.

Replay starts an isolated interpreter importing the captured comparison package, reuses captured suite/budget/timeouts, refuses existing output, and verifies the resulting bundle. This is source inspection of the replay path, not a replay execution result.
